prompts.surfaces: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture atlas for a premium top-down UK truck arcade driving game. Create ONE 2048x2048 square sheet divided into exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of equally sized square MATERIAL SWATCHES; no gutters, no words, no borders, no roads or lane markings. Orthographic overhead, richly rendered materials with restrained micro-detail and uniform soft daylight. Row 1 left to right: charcoal worn asphalt; warm brown compacted dirt with tire ruts; pale grey concrete sidewalk slabs; lush finely textured mown grass. Row 2: golden harvested field stubble; muddy dark earth with shallow puddles; fine pale gravel; small grey urban block pavers. Row 3: rust-red bricks flat roof; slate grey roofing; dark green dense foliage canopy; sand and construction earth. Row 4: meadow grass with tiny wildflowers; pale farmland soil; dark river water subtle ripples; sparse aggregate asphalt variation. Each cell fills its 512x512 square and has no objects casting large shadows, no text or symbols. Tile-friendly subtle materials for seamless scrolling scenery. Realistic polished 3D game textures, visually consistent lighting. Do not draw a board or an isometric scene.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium top-down UK truck arcade game transparent sprite atlas. ONE 2048x2048 sheet exactly 4 columns x 4 rows equal cells, each object centred in its own cell with at least 35px transparent padding all around, no overlap across cells. True orthographic overhead camera, north at top, visually consistent finely rendered PBR-style materials, attractive saturated but believable mobile game art, crisp readable silhouettes and subtle soft contact shadows, transparent background. Row 1 left to right: detached British red brick house grey roof and tiny green garden; mature oak tree crown; red brick garage with forecourt; dense green hedgerow segment vertical. Row 2: orange excavator with short digging arm; long red-white construction barrier horizontal with orange lamps; small road excavation pit with broken asphalt rim; stacked blue-grey steel road panels and timber sleepers. Row 3: irregular wet muddy tire ruts patch; irregular rainbow oil slick; short white-red pedestrian access bollards with paved patch; wooden farm gate with hedge ends. Row 4: polished gold pickup prize token; green illuminated trailer hitch/coupling pickup icon; chrome twin exhaust pipes; blue-white roof auxiliary light bar. Objects are separate game sprites, no labels, no typography, no decorative frames. Genuine alpha outside all objects. Detailed rendered art, not flat icons.
prompts.trucks: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent truck sprites for a premium portrait UK truck-driving arcade game. ONE 2048x1024 sprite atlas: exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, equal 512x512 cells, each component centered with generous transparent margins, nothing crosses cells. Camera STRICT TRUE TOP DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC looking straight down, front of each truck points UP, NO isometric perspective. Very high quality rendered miniature vehicle materials with detailed metallic paint, machined wheels, black rubber, silver tanks, dark windows and amber beacons. Row 1 left to right: turquoise modern European cab-over tractor truck with cab roof in the top 55%, exposed black chassis and fifth wheel in lower 45%; EXACT SAME tractor in orange; EXACT SAME tractor in deep violet; separate long pale ivory box semi-trailer front at top, clean ribbed roof, rear doors and axle wheels at bottom. Row 2 left to right: separate shorter flatbed trailer with restrained timber and steel load; separate pair of chrome exhaust stacks oriented vertically and viewed overhead; separate horizontal blue-white roof light bar seen overhead; separate cream small roof air-conditioning pod viewed overhead. Each truck cab has matching width and length, trailer same width as tractors, all game components detailed crisp and readable at small size, true transparency, no lettering, no logo, no road or background. The connection needs to look mechanically convincing. Only draw the eight specified objects.
prompts.trucks_alpha: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact truck sprite atlas. Remove ALL white and pale background between and around the eight separate objects, producing truly transparent alpha zero surrounding every object. Preserve all eight trucks, trailers and accessories exactly, same positions, dimensions, materials, colours and lighting. Do not remove white trailer body. No added elements, no background, no checkerboard pixels, no semi-opaque white sheet. This is an actual game sprite sheet requiring complete transparency outside each sprite.
prompts.showroom: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 8-angle turntable sprite atlas of the TURQUOISE European tractor truck in the reference with its ivory box semi trailer correctly hitched. ONE 2048x1024 image, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows of equally sized cells. Each cell contains ONE complete identical turquoise-and-ivory articulated lorry, centred, whole truck visible, transparent padding, same wheelbase, same body details and scale in every frame. Camera is at a fixed 30 degree elevation above ground, orthographic lens, truck on level ground. View directions progress CLOCKWISE around the truck at exactly 45 degree intervals. Row1: directly FRONT grille facing camera; front-right THREE QUARTER; directly RIGHT SIDE cab at left and trailer at right; rear-right THREE QUARTER. Row2: directly REAR trailer doors; rear-left THREE QUARTER; directly LEFT SIDE cab at right and trailer at left; front-left THREE QUARTER. World lighting fixed soft studio daylight, premium richly rendered metallic paint and chrome, realistic wheels and chassis. This is eight different camera views of the SAME full truck, not eight flat rotations of a topdown image. No turntable base, no scenery, no typography, no frames, no watermark. Truly transparent empty background outside objects, fully opaque truck objects.
prompts.showroom_alpha: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the reference sheet to produce a usable game sprite atlas. Make all the white/grey studio background around the eight trucks COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT alpha zero, including all space between trucks; retain the trucks opaque, including ivory trailers. Preserve exact four-column two-row layout and all truck poses and scale. Only correction: the truck in the BOTTOM RIGHT cell must be the front-LEFT three-quarter view with cab on the RIGHT of that cell and trailer trailing to the LEFT (horizontal mirror of its current pose). Keep every other cell unchanged. Remove floor contact shadows outside truck silhouette. NO grey or white sheet, no checkerboard pattern. Actual transparent PNG sprite cutouts.
prompts.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-end topdown UK driving game modular SCENERY SPRITES, matching detailed miniature 3D-rendered mobile game art. Create one 2048x1024 sheet exactly FOUR columns x TWO rows of separate props with true transparent background and generous margin in each cell. High overhead orthographic camera tilted only slightly to show some building facade, north up, uniform soft daylight. Row1 left to right: compact pair of British terraced high-street shops with slate roofs and colourful awnings; small modern distribution warehouse with blue roller shutter and rooftop vents; rustic red-brick countryside barn with weathered roof and stacked hay; small British semi-detached housing pair with neat gardens, red tile roofs. Row2 left to right: compact construction compound with two stacked teal shipping containers and bundled timber; landscaped traffic island with one mature tree and rounded curb, NO road surrounding it; clear shallow river-water patch with rough grassy banks along left and right, top and bottom open; small roadside bus shelter with transparent glass, dark roof and bench. No people, no vehicles, no text, no street names, no signs, no logo. Each whole prop centered in its own equal cell, no overlaps, no backgrounds except the tiny base directly under each prop. Crisp textured PBR-like art, not simple geometric block assets. Objects themselves fully opaque, all space around them actual alpha zero.
